name: Ad Hoc
description: Policies, procedures, and strategies are not formalized; activities are performed in an ad-hoc, reactive manner.

name: Defined
description: Policies, procedures, and strategies are formalized and documented but not consistently implemented.

name: Consistently Implemented
description: Policies, procedures, and strategies are consistently implemented, but quantitative and qualitative effectiveness measures are lacking.

name: Managed and Measurable
description: Quantitative and qualitative measures on the effectiveness of policies, procedures, and strategies are collected across the organization and used to assess them and make necessary changes.

name: Optimized
description: Policies, procedures, and strategies are fully institutionalized, repeatable, self-generating, and regularly updated based on a changing threat and technology landscape and business/mission needs.
